title: tidy gives an undecidable recorded leftover the verdict ask, records the operator's answer through coord, and claims a candidate before removing it
goal: bl_clean.safe_to_remove gives the verdict ask to a recorded, clean and merged candidate whose item is still claimed with no live coord lease, or whose process outlives its recorded session's lease, with the candidate's key in its row; backlog.py tidy --decide KEY remove|keep records the operator's answer as a coord value of that key, refused in an agent session; tidy --apply removes an ask candidate answered remove only after it claims the coord key clean/<KEY>, and while another holder has that claim it removes nothing and exits 1

run:
import sys
def _fail(t, e, tb, _d=sys.excepthook):
    if issubclass(t, AssertionError):
        print("check failed:", e); sys.exit(1)
    _d(t, e, tb)
sys.excepthook = _fail
import os, subprocess, sys, tempfile, json, time
T = tempfile.mkdtemp()
ENV = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith(("GIT_", "KB_COORD"))}
ENV.pop("CLAUDECODE", None)
ENV.update(KB_COORD_STORE=os.path.join(T, "coord.sqlite"), GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=os.devnull, GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM="1",
           GIT_AUTHOR_NAME="t", GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL="t@example.com", GIT_COMMITTER_NAME="t", GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL="t@example.com")
def g(*a, cwd):
    return subprocess.run(["git", *a], cwd=cwd, env=ENV, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout
def tool(*a, env=None, ok=(0,)):
    r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, *a], capture_output=True, text=True, env=env or ENV, timeout=300)
    assert r.returncode in ok, (a, r.returncode, r.stdout[-800:], r.stderr[-800:])
    return r
O, C = os.path.join(T, "origin.git"), os.path.join(T, "clone")
g("init", "-q", "--bare", "-b", "main", O, cwd=T)
g("clone", "-q", O, C, cwd=T)
os.makedirs(os.path.join(C, "kb", "_self", "backlog"))
open(os.path.join(C, "backlog.json"), "w").write('{"item_dir": "kb/_self/backlog"}\n')
open(os.path.join(C, "kb", "_self", "backlog", ".keep"), "w").close()
g("add", "-A", cwd=C); g("commit", "-qm", "base", cwd=C); g("push", "-q", "origin", "main", cwd=C); g("fetch", "-q", cwd=C)
WT = os.path.join(C, ".claude", "worktrees")
def wt(name, branch=None, at="HEAD"):
    p = os.path.join(WT, name)
    g("worktree", "add", "-q", *(["-b", branch] if branch else ["--detach"]), p, at, cwd=C)
    return p
n = lambda p: os.path.normcase(os.path.realpath(p))
def own(p, cls, *a, env=None):
    return tool("_tools/backlog.py", "--root", C, "own", str(p), "--class", cls, *a, env=env)
def rows(*a):
    return json.loads(tool("_tools/backlog.py", "--root", C, "tidy", "--json", *a).stdout)
def by_path(rs, cls=None):
    return {n(x["path"]): x for x in rs if "path" in x and (cls is None or x.get("class") == cls)}
S = ENV["KB_COORD_STORE"]
it = {"id": "ST-aaaaaaaa", "kind": "story", "title": "t", "status": "doing", "priority": "P2", "rank": 0, "goal": "g",
      "checks": [{"run": ["true"]}], "touches": ["x"]}
open(os.path.join(C, "kb", "_self", "backlog", "ST-aaaaaaaa.json"), "w").write(json.dumps(it, indent=2) + "\n")
g("add", "-A", cwd=C); g("commit", "-qm", "item", cwd=C); g("push", "-q", "origin", "main", cwd=C); g("fetch", "-q", cwd=C)
st = wt("agent-stale", "work/ST-aaaaaaaa"); own(st, "worktree", "--item", "ST-aaaaaaaa", "--session", "s-gone")
x = by_path(rows("--older-than", "0"), "worktree")[n(st)]
assert x["verdict"] == "ask" and "claim" in x["reason"] and x.get("key"), x
key = x["key"]
tool("_tools/backlog.py", "--root", C, "tidy", "--decide", key, "remove", env=dict(ENV, CLAUDECODE="1"), ok=(2,))
tool("_tools/backlog.py", "--root", C, "tidy", "--decide", key, "remove")
held = json.loads(tool("_tools/coord.py", "--store", S, "claim", "clean/" + key, "--ttl", "600", "--holder", "other").stdout)
r = tool("_tools/backlog.py", "--root", C, "tidy", "--apply", "--older-than", "0", ok=(1,))
assert os.path.isdir(st), ("removed a candidate another holder claims", r.stdout)
tool("_tools/coord.py", "--store", S, "release", "clean/" + key, "--token", held["token"])
tool("_tools/backlog.py", "--root", C, "tidy", "--apply", "--older-than", "0")
assert not os.path.exists(st), "an answered, unclaimed candidate stays"

clauses.clause: bl_clean.safe_to_remove gives the verdict ask to a recorded, clean and merged candidate whose item is still claimed with no live coord lease, or whose process outlives its recorded session's lease, with the candidate's key in its row
backlog.py tidy --decide KEY remove|keep records the operator's answer as a coord value of that key, refused in an agent session
tidy --apply removes an ask candidate answered remove only after it claims the coord key clean/<KEY>
while another holder has that claim it removes nothing and exits 1

notes: Test policy (D-6kei5o2z, D-2tq4fhgs): no new test or test file; the checks are tool runs on a throwaway clone with its own coord store and a stand-in claude on PATH, so no paid model call; no change to _tools/tests_ceiling.json. An uncommitted worktree stays keep even when answered: tidy never passes --force, so a dirty one is reported for a hand clean. Starts after SP-ipeewrlv has landed bl_clean.py.
